title: Pollution regulation on plant total factor productivity
research_question: Did tightened air quality regulations (period 4) reduce total factor productivity at high-emission manufacturing plants compared to low-emission plants?
data_description: Panel data on 200 manufacturing plants over 8 annual periods. Variables: unit_id, period, treated (1=high-emission plant above regulatory threshold), post, treat_x_post, y (log TFP index). Regulation mandates emission reductions for plants above a pollution threshold.
